# Crease Sports — refined sports-store identity

Current design: simplified equipment badge with a cricket bat, red cricket ball, football and racket. The lettering uses outlined Barlow Condensed Black with an 18% forward slant; the tagline uses outlined Barlow Condensed SemiBold. Orange Sports lettering and an orange separator line pair with forest-green/cream lettering for light/dark themes.

The tagline source cap height is 19 units, previously 8.2. At the desktop header width of 264px, this is approximately 11.4px instead of 4.5px. Header/footer sizes adapt at the existing breakpoints. PNG wordmark exports are 1760×448.

The equipment illustration was created using the built-in image-generation tool, with transparency. It is embedded as a small PNG inside the web SVGs; PNG wordmark exports use the original-resolution image. An SVG clipping outline keeps the circular badge edge clean while retaining the bat grip. The lettering is vector outlines. Font licences remain in assets/fonts.

## Current illustration prompt

Use case: logo-brand. Asset: a refined premium illustrated emblem for Crease Sports, a cricket and sports equipment retailer. Create ONLY the illustrated symbol, no text anywhere. A clean circular badge containing a natural willow cricket bat, a vivid deep-red stitched cricket ball in the foreground, a small classic black-and-white football and a badminton racket behind them. The bat and red ball dominate and the football and racket remain recognisable. Compact, balanced, elegant sports-store illustration, clear silhouette and strong simplified contours for a small website header. Cream/ivory circular disc with ONE thin burnt-orange perimeter ring. All objects fully inside the circle, no cropped handles. Dark forest-green bat grip and racket, warm natural willow blade, fine but restrained leather seam. A polished contemporary illustration with smooth controlled shading and a few crisp outlines, close to high-quality sporting-goods packaging artwork. Fewer tiny details, more clear shapes. Transparent background outside badge, 5 percent transparent margin around it. No lettering, no monogram, no C, no slashes, no ribbons, NO LEAVES, NO LAURELS, NO botanical decorations, no crown, no trophy, no busy hatching, no vintage engraving, no grunge, no outer drop-shadow, no mockup, no extra objects. Warm orange #ef4d26 and deep forest #20392c accents. Professional, stylish and immediately identifiable as cricket and multi-sport gear.
